answer: The ember of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the haven of the next round. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit.
